sets.name: Services agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of a technology services agreement between Provider and Telcostar/Ability Computer & Software Industries, likely for a potential investment, acquisition, or partnership.

items.name: Exhibit A – Description of Services
items.what_it_is: The schedule attached to the Services Agreement that details the specific services, deliverables, timelines, and performance standards the Provider must furnish.
items.why_needed: To verify the scope of obligations and assess whether the services match the business purpose and value contemplated in the deal.

items.name: Board Resolutions Authorizing the Agreement
items.what_it_is: Formal resolutions of the board of directors (or equivalent governing body) of Provider, Telcostar Pte Ltd, and Ability Computer & Software Industries Ltd approving entry into the Services Agreement.
items.why_needed: To confirm that each party had proper corporate authority to bind itself, a standard requirement in M&A and investment diligence.

items.name: Audited Financial Statements (latest fiscal year) of Provider and Recipients
items.what_it_is: Balance sheets, income statements, cash‑flow statements, and accompanying notes audited by an independent accountant for each party.
items.why_needed: To evaluate financial capacity to perform the services and to identify any liabilities that could affect the transaction.

items.name: Material Contracts Schedule
items.what_it_is: A list of all other significant agreements (customer, supplier, financing, licensing, etc.) to which each party is a party, as required under the agreement’s representations.
items.why_needed: To detect potential conflicts, change‑of‑control triggers, or obligations that could impact the service arrangement.

items.name: Intellectual Property Assignment / Licensing Documents
items.what_it_is: Agreements transferring or licensing any IP (software, know‑how, patents) that the Provider will use or create in delivering the services.
items.why_needed: To ensure the Provider has the right to use necessary IP and that the Recipient receives any IP developed under the agreement.

items.name: Confidentiality / Non‑Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
items.what_it_is: A standalone NDA or confidentiality provisions governing the exchange of proprietary information between the parties prior to or alongside the Services Agreement.
items.why_needed: To verify protection of confidential information and assess any limitations on use or disclosure that could affect diligence findings.

items.name: Telecommunications Regulatory Licenses (if applicable)
items.what_it_is: Copies of any licenses, permits, or authorizations required for the Provider to offer telecom‑related services in Singapore, Israel, or other jurisdictions.
items.why_needed: To confirm legal ability to perform the services and avoid regulatory risk that could impair the agreement’s value.

items.name: Certificate of Insurance (Professional Liability / General Liability)
items.what_it_is: Insurance certificates showing coverage limits and policy periods for professional liability, general liability, and any other relevant policies held by the Provider.
items.why_needed: To assess risk mitigation and ensure the Provider can cover potential claims arising from service performance.
